# SportsFirst

> > SportsFirst provides sports technology APIs and sustainability partnerships for athlete performance tracking, health biometrics, and eco-friendly sports operations.

SportsFirst integrates leading sports technology APIs including Biostrap, Catapult Sports, and Under Armour Connected Fitness for comprehensive athlete monitoring and performance analytics. The platform also partners with sustainability consultants like Jabroyd to promote environmental responsibility in sports operations.

## Sports Technology APIs

- [Biostrap API](https://www.sportsfirst.net/sportsapi/biostrap): Biostrap API for health biometrics and clinical-grade fitness tracking
- [Catapult Sports API](https://www.sportsfirst.net/sportsapi/catapult-sports-api): Catapult Sports API for athlete tracking and performance analytics
- [Under Armour Connected Fitness API](https://www.sportsfirst.net/sportsapi/under-armour-connected-fitness-api): Under Armour API for fitness tracking and nutrition data integration

## Partnerships & Sustainability

- [Jabroyd](https://www.sportsfirst.net/partners/jabroyd): Jabroyd sustainability consulting partnership for eco-friendly sports ops
